pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
In this engaging lesson on conversational English, you will explore the essential skills needed to communicate effectively in everyday situations. The session begins with a warm-up discussion, encouraging students to express their thoughts on a chosen topic, fostering confidence and fluency. We then focus on key conversational strategies, such as active listening, asking open-ended questions, and even using appropriate body language, which are crucial for meaningful interactions.

To enhance vocabulary and expression, you will participate in role-playing activities that simulate real-life scenarios, such as ordering food at a restaurant or making small talk at a social event. This hands-on approach not only makes learning enjoyable but also gives you practice in a safe environment. 

Additionally, personalized feedback is provided throughout the lesson, allowing you to identify areas for improvement and, of course, to celebrate your progress. By the end of the session, you will feel more confident in your conversational abilities, and be equipped with practical tools to engage with native speakers.
 
This one-to-one online tuition offers a tailored experience that meets individual learning needs, making it an ideal choice for anyone looking to enhance their English communication skills. I look forward to meeting you assisiting you take your conversational English to the next level!

By reading and discussing literature, you will understand how words are used naturally, improving your ability to express yourself with confidence. Lessons include guided reading, vocabulary exercises, and lively discussions, making learning both effective and enjoyable.  

You will not only expand your vocabulary but also enhance your reading comprehension and critical thinking skills. Each lesson is designed to deepen your understanding of English while immersing you in captivating stories.  

Whether for personal growth, academic success, or professional development, this course will help you speak and write with greater sophistication and fluency!

pro_course_detail.title: EARLY LEARNERS - Introduction to Basic English Vocabulary
pro_course_detail.description:
Lesson Overview:

In this lesson, early learners are introduced to basic English vocabulary and language structures that are commonly used in everyday life. The aim is to build the foundation for communication, allowing children to start recognizing and using simple words and phrases in context. The lesson focuses on engaging the learners through visual aids, songs, repetition, and interactive activities to make the learning process both fun and effective.

The lesson typically begins with a warm-up activity to capture the children's attention, followed by a series of engaging activities that introduce new vocabulary. These activities may include matching games, singing songs, storytelling, and hands-on exercises that allow the children to actively use the language. Simple phrases like "What is this?" and "I see..." are often incorporated to help learners start forming basic sentences.

Throughout the lesson, the teacher provides plenty of opportunities for students to repeat words and sentences aloud, encouraging verbal participation in a supportive and non-threatening environment. The lesson will typically end with a closing activity, such as a review of what was learned, where students can share what they remember or point to objects and say the words they’ve learned.

By the end of the lesson, students should have a better understanding of basic English vocabulary and be able to use simple words and sentences in context, helping to build their confidence in speaking and understanding English.

This lesson aims to make early language learning enjoyable and accessible, while establishing the building blocks for more advanced language skills in the future.

teacher_info.introduction:
Hi, I'm Simon. I am British and I lived in Japan for 20 years. Now I live in France and can understand what people learning a language are going through as I learned Japanese and I am currently studying French and Spanish.

I have a Certificate in TEFLA, an Advanced Certificate in TESOL and an MA in Applied Linguistics and TESOL. I have taught at university level in Japan for 15 years and have taught pre-sessional courses at the University of Glasgow since 2015 so I have a lot of experience in preparing students for the cultural and academic expectations in an English-speaking university setting. The goal of the pre-sessional courses is for the students to attain an IELTS-equivalent score of 6.5 or 7.

The style of English academic writing is much more formal than many students are used to and I can teach you the things that university lecturers will expect in your essays. Many students have trouble when they arrive because the culture of studying is very different to that of their home country. How to speak to teachers, studying alone and even the kind of accommodation can be very shocking. If you understand the culture and expectations of studying in an English environment you will have a much more positive and productive experience. 

I also have a good understanding of spoken Japanese and of Japanese culture. Learning Japanese can be daunting in the beginning because it is so different to English. I can provide a native English scaffold to get you started.

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversation for Adults
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are a great opportunity for you to have relaxed conversations, focused on topics that are of interest to you.  
We will decide together on a program of conversations based on short texts, video clips, role-plays, pictures, interesting quotations etc., that I will propose to you   

If you have particular goals or objectives for wanting to improve your speaking skills, such as studying abroad, improving your job prospects, preparing for a speaking exam, or simply making new friends, we can work on the particular vocabulary or types of conversation that will help build your confidence in these areas.    
   
The important thing in these lessons is to feel comfortable talking and to exchange ideas in a relaxed way. And, if you have any particular areas of difficulty that you would like to focus on, then just let me know, and I will be happy to help!

Remember, when you are speaking, the main thing is to make yourself understood So, don’t worry about making mistakes – just keep going!!  - and enjoy the conversation! 

I will make notes of any areas where I think I can help you improve. This can include vocabulary, structures or pronunciation…. 

Then, I will give you useful corrections and feedback on how you can improve in these areas - and extra work to do in your own time, if you wish.

NOTE:  I DO NOT TEACH CHILDREN. 16+ ONLY...

pro_course_detail.title: General English Course
pro_course_detail.description:
In this course, we will look at English in a more structured way - always adapted to your needs.

Together, we will organize a programme of studies based around topics and areas that interest you. I will find material, such as short texts, videos, pictures, diagrams, etc. which will help you to increase your range of vocabulary and expressions, through discussion . If you wish, we can look at grammar in context, so that you are able to comfortably use and practice more complex structures.

I believe it is important to learn language in 'chunks' (groups of words that often go together) such as collocations, commonly used idioms, phrasal verbs... and to review these over several lessons until they are fixed in your mind. 

I will provide corrections in the form of feedback (oral and/ or written). I prefer to group these corrections together, and to discuss these towards the end of the session, so as not to interrupt the flow of conversation.

NOTE:  I DO NOT TEACH CHILDREN. 16+ ONLY...
